color.note: Canonical brand values come from SLSFC_Crest_Master_RGB.ai: navy #042644 and orange #FC4B08. orange-deep and crest-white are colors inside the crest artwork, kept for reference and narrow UI use, not general brand colors. slate and paper come from the identity boards. Every other value is a digital addition. Light is the 'away kit' (white ground); dark is the 'home kit' (navy ground).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy — the crest field, from the master crest. The club's anchor color: headlines on light grounds, the dark-theme page, bands, the home kit. Supersedes the boards' #082A4A / #08244A.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Digital addition, a darker step of navy. Label color on orange fills (5.2:1 on orange) and the dark-theme band. Never a substitute for navy in the crest or logo lockups.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Brand orange — the crest's tail and outer border, from the master crest. Supersedes the boards' #F15A24. Fills, accent bars, link underlines, large display type (24px+), icons and the focus ring. Not body-size text (3.4:1 on white): text stays ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: orange-deep
tokens.usage: Shading inside the crest artwork (master crest). Not a general brand color. Approved UI use, limited to one place: the light-theme value of accent-text, the orange soft Tag label (4.8:1 on accent-soft). Never a fill.

tokens.name: crest-white
tokens.usage: The white inside the master crest. Used only where a flat recreation of crest colors is needed (print specs); UI uses white.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white from the boards. Light-theme page and card ground; text on navy and on band.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Board slate (#A7B0B8; the kit board's '#A78088' is a typo for this). Mono crest tint, muted text on navy (7.0:1), dividers on dark grounds. Never text on white (2.2:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The cool off-white ground of the identity boards (sampled). Alternate section ground in the light theme.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating page sections, table stripes, input wells.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, dialogs. In light it relies on line or shadow-sm to separate from surface.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Full-bleed navy bands: hero, values band, footer. Text on it is on-band; accents are orange.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text and icons on band (15.4:1 light, 17:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-band-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on band (7.0:1 light).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only — never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders, any border that defines a control (3.9:1 on white, 3.5:1 on paper; 3.6:1 on surface-raised dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on surface, surface-alt and surface-raised in both themes (light 13.9:1 or better; dark 12.5:1 or better). Also links, ghost actions and nav links.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions and eyebrows on surface, surface-alt and surface-raised (light 6.1:1 or better; dark 5.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand orange as a mark: accent bars, link underlines, active-nav bar, icons, stripes, large display numerals. Not for body-size text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Approved for the orange soft Tag label only, on accent-soft (light 4.8:1, dark 6.1:1). Not for eyebrows, links or navigation — those use ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the orange Tag, behind accent-text.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on action and action-hover (5.2:1 / 6.2:1). Never white on orange: 3.4:1 fails at button size.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px gap in the surface color, then a solid 2px orange ring (3.4:1 on white, 3.1:1 on paper, 4.5:1 on navy, 3.6:1 on surface-raised dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Status: 'On', confirmed, registered. Always with a word. On the surfaces and success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Status: weather watch, limited spots, waitlist. Always with a word. On the surfaces and caution-soft.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind caution text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Status: cancelled, form errors. A crimson kept well apart from brand orange in lightness; always paired with a word or icon so it never relies on hue. On the surfaces and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: APPROVED (v1.0) — Barlow Condensed (Google Fonts), the SLSFC display face. The condensed, heavy, athletic voice. Italic 800 for the biggest moments; headings upright 700; uppercase. Not the SQUIRRELS wordmark: never used to imitate it, and never in its place once the wordmark artwork exists.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the home hero and season launches. Uppercase. Drops to 56px under 640px wide. The sample is set type, not the SQUIRRELS wordmark.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Landing-page heroes and campaign headers. Uppercase. 40px under 640px.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section titles, under an eyebrow. Uppercase.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Scores, jersey numbers, key figures. Use tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

groups.name: Text
groups.note: APPROVED (v1.0) — Barlow (Google Fonts), the SLSFC text face. Pairs with the boards' wide-tracked captions. Sentence case for reading; tracked uppercase for labels.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Every player gets a team, a coach and a place to grow.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs under a hero or section title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Practices run Tuesday and Thursday evenings in Webster Groves.
styles.usage: Default reading text. Sentence case. Measure 60–72 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Supporting text, card meta, form help.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tags, nav links, table headers. Always uppercase.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The wide-tracked caption from the boards: above section titles, captions on imagery. Uppercase, in ink-muted (on-band-muted on band), with the accent bar carrying the orange.

spacing.note: 4px base. Section rhythm uses the large steps; components use space-2 to space-6.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to accent bar, tag padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps in button rows and meta lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (mobile), page gutter on phones, form field gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (desktop), grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Heading to content; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding (mobile).

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding (desktop), hero padding.

radius.note: Square-shouldered like the shield and the kit trim: corners stay small. No pills, no large rounding.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Bands, images bleeding to an edge, the accent bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, image frames.

shadow.note: Separation comes from color blocks and lines first. Shadows are low and navy-tinted.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards on surface.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, menus, dialogs.

size.note: Fixed dimensions that carry the brand's signatures.

tokens.name: accent-bar-width
tokens.usage: The short orange rule from the boards, under eyebrows and section labels.

tokens.name: accent-bar-height
tokens.usage: Thickness of the accent bar.

tokens.name: trim-stripe
tokens.usage: Each band of the kit-collar trim (navy / white / orange) used as a divider on bands and footers.

tokens.name: crest-min
tokens.usage: Smallest on-screen crest height. Below this use a text name, not the crest.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs; also the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width; gutters are space-4 (phone) and space-8 (desktop).
